process: Each contributor independently generates a 32-byte secret.
Contributor publishes SHA-256 commitment before reveal window closes.
After all commitments are frozen, contributors reveal their 32-byte secret.
Missing reveals are replaced by SHA-256('missing'||commitment) as specified by bootstrap randomness rules.
Contributor records are canonicalized by contributor_id.
The ceremony tool computes contributor_ceremony_root and final genesis seed.
All source inputs and outputs are published with checksums.
